svg.title: Ksolves Operator for Apache NiFi — System overview
svg.desc: The platform team applies NiFiCluster and NiFiNodeGroup resources to the Kubernetes API, which admits them through the operator's webhooks; the operator manager watches them and reconciles each NiFi cluster's node-group StatefulSets, a TLS CSI driver issues per-pod certificates, NiFi nodes coordinate through Kubernetes Leases instead of ZooKeeper, and users reach NiFi over HTTPS.
svg.text: NiFi 2.12 · one StatefulSet per node group
